subject: How to change from mediation to moderator model

messages.author: 9e0c8eda69bfc14c
messages.subject: How to change from mediation to moderator model
parts:
This was my multiple mediational model. 

Independent V: BE

Mediator 1 : BC total (BC_Climate + BC_Adult + BC_peer + BC_teacher)

Mediator 2: BRS total (BRS_Adult + BRS_Peer )

Outcome: SB

But, how can I change it to moderator analysis?

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

multipleMediation model<- '

SB~ b1 * BC_Climate + b2 * BC_Adult + b3 * BC_peer + b4 * BC_teacher + 

  c1 * BRS_Adult + c2 *  BRS_Peer + d * BE 

BC_Climate ~ e1 * BE + BC_Adult + BC_peer + BC_teacher

BC_Adult ~ e2 * BE+ BC_Climate + BC_peer + BC_teacher

BC_peer ~ e3 * BE+ BC_Climate + BC_Adult + BC_teacher

BC_teacher ~ e4 * BE+ BC_Climate + BC_Adult + BC_peer

BRS_Adult ~ f1 * BE + BRS_Peer

BRS_Peer ~ f2 * BE + BRS_Adult

bc.cli.BE.indirect := b1 * e1

bc.au.BE.indirect := b2 * e2

bc.pe.BE.indirect := b3 * e3

bc.te.BE.indirect := b4 * e4

brs.au.BE.indirect := c1 * f1

brs.pe.BE.indirect := c2 * f2

total.ind := bc.cli.BE.indirect + bc.au.BE.indirect + bc.pe.BE.indirect +

  bc.te.BE.indirect + brs.au.BE.indirect + brs.pe.BE.indirect

total := d + total.ind

'

parts:
Those are very different hypotheses, and you have told us nothing about what yours are.  Here is a lavaan example of a moderated mediation model, which shows how you can include product terms among observed variables to model an interaction.
